labelled_transcript: Therapist. Hello Maya. Child. I went somewhere really fancy at the weekend. I went to a big restaurant for my mum's birthday, and the waiter brought out a cake with sparklers on it. Therapist. Sparklers on a cake? Child. Yes, like little fireworks. Therapist. Have you been anywhere fancy? Child. I went to my auntie's wedding. Auntie Shona. Therapist. Auntie Shona's wedding! Where was it? Child. In a castle. Therapist. A real castle with a tower. Child. A real castle with a tower. Therapist. Who else was there? Child. Uncle Dev and my cousins and my mum and my dad and loads and loads of people. Therapist. Loads and loads of people. What did you do at the wedding? Child. I had a sparkly dress. It was purple with a bow on the back. Therapist. A purple sparkly dress with a bow. Child. And shiny shoes. Therapist. They was a bit too big. Child. A bit too big. Therapist. Hmm. So what happened at the wedding? Child. I don't remember. Therapist. That's okay. Was it a nice day? Child. It was the best day ever. Therapist. The best ever ever. Child. The best day ever! Therapist. You must have been so excited when you woke up that morning. Child. My cousin Leo is four. He's a baby. Leo's four. Therapist. Do you have a lot of cousins? Child. Five. No, six. Therapist. Six cousins. Child. Six cousins! Therapist. And how did the day finish? Child. We went home in a taxi when it was really really dark. I falled asleep in the taxi. Therapist. You fell asleep in the taxi. Let me say your story back. You went to Auntie Shona's wedding in a real castle with a tower. Uncle Dev was there, and your cousins, and Mum and Dad, and loads and loads of people. You had a purple sparkly dress with a bow, and shiny shoes that were a bit too big. Child. It was the best day ever. Therapist. Then you went home in a taxi when it was really dark, and you fell asleep. Child. In the taxi. Therapist. In the taxi. Thanks, Maya. Child. Can I tell you about my dress again? Therapist. Of course you can.
